# Narrow overrides

<!-- cspell:words Fixturebrand -->
Fixturebrand appears twice inside this Fixturebrand-only case study.

<!-- cspell:ignore Oneofftokn -->
Oneofftokn appears once.

<!-- writing-override: Preserve the quoted historical spelling on this single line. -->
<!-- cspell:disable-next-line -->
singlelinemisspellng is quoted from the original label.

<!-- writing-override: Preserve this deliberately unedited historical sample as written. -->
<!-- cspell:disable -->
rangemisspellng appears only inside this bounded quotation.
<!-- cspell:enable -->

<!-- writing-override: Preserve the historical lowercase product name in this quotation. -->
<!-- vale Alkahest.Terminology["typst"] = NO -->
The typst spelling is deliberate in this one quotation.
<!-- vale Alkahest.Terminology["typst"] = YES -->

<!-- writing-override: Preserve several historical product spellings in this bounded quotation. -->
<!-- vale Alkahest.Terminology = NO -->
The vale and typst spellings are deliberate in this bounded quotation.
<!-- vale Alkahest.Terminology = YES -->
